errors.evidence: The description misinterprets the basis for the distribution. The original caption specifies distribution by "позицията, която заемат" (the position they hold), not their "дял" (share).

errors.text_span: “Директор на клиенти”, “Мениджър ръководни клиенти”, “Директор на департамент”, “Вицепрезидент на департамент” и “Акаунт мениджър”
errors.evidence: The description lists several category labels incorrectly. For example, it says "Директор на клиенти" instead of "Директор на отдел", "Мениджър ръководни клиенти" instead of "Мениджър ключови клиенти", and adds "на департамент" to "Вицепрезидент".
The list of categories provided in the description is incomplete and omits several positions shown in the chart, such as "Мениджър екип" and "Технически ръководител".
The description incorrectly states that the positions are sorted alphabetically. The bars are sorted in descending order based on their value.
The description omits any details about the vertical axis, such as its scale (which is unmarked but has gridlines) and the fact that it is not labeled, as requested by the prompt.
The value for the bar "Мениджър услуги" is incorrectly reported as 7. The chart clearly shows the value is 13.
The value for the bar "Процесен инженер" is incorrectly reported as 6. The chart shows the value is 7.

errors.text_span: Стълбите за останалите позиции са с височина 6, 6, 5, 5, 5, 4 и 4.
errors.evidence: The list of the remaining values is incorrect. The chart shows four bars with a value of 5, but the description only lists three.
The description claims that the different colors of the bars represent different departments. There is no legend or any other information in the figure to support this claim.

errors.text_span: На дъното на диаграмата е посочена легенда, която асоциира всеки цвят със съответната позиция.
errors.evidence: The description falsely claims there is a legend at the bottom of the chart. The labels at the bottom are the x-axis category labels, not a legend that maps colors to positions.
